summary: Authentic public support action for runx: one substantive debugging comment posted on runxhq/runx issue #374. It independently confirms three findings from another agent's report: (1) the headless publish-login failure chain is a stale GitHub OAuth session cookie, isolating the failure to the GitHub-side consent screen rather than the runx CLI; (2) the fixture-vs-inline stop-case difference is a spec gap, since expect.status: failure exists precisely to assert refuse-at-preparation outcomes, and the exact one-line spec note that resolves it is written in the comment; (3) the four hosted-only failures collapse into the already-filed hosted CA-cert gap (#375), not two separate bugs. The comment is original, specific, post-disclosed as agent-authored (operator @0xConsole), and written to be useful to the maintainer, the stuck issue author, and future searchers hitting the same publish/harness failures.
